thread.title: These U.S. stocks rose as much as 15% Tuesday as the market bounced back

author: Philip van Doorn
title: These U.S. stocks rose as much as 15% Tuesday as the market bounced back
text:
What a difference a day makes. 
After a 4.6% decline Monday when all 30 of its component stocks were down , the Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed 2.3% Tuesday , with all but four stocks rising for the session. 
And following Monday’s 4.1% whipping for the S&P 500 Index, with all but two of its component stocks dropping, the index rebounded 1.7% Tuesday as about four of every five shares advanced.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +2.33% is now once again in the red for 2018, with a gain of 0.8%, not including dividends. Here’s how all 30 components of the oldest stock-market index performed Tuesday:
